d: When the team investigates the death of a sailor outside Baltimore, Tony sees a former police informant he thought was dead.
NCIS has to work together with the coast guard to investigate a suspicious explosion on an oil platform.
When an unstoppable assassin hunts down Cat and Vincent, they attempt to lure him out of town and away from their loved ones with the ruse that they plan to elope.
As Cat and Vincent approach their wedding day, Vincent, JT and Tess do all they can to keep a worried Cat focused on her big day.
The detectives search for a rapist targeting Asian women. Later, the perpetrator claims in defence that he inherited the 'violence gene' from his father.
Benson and Stabler investigate when the battered body of a young girl in foster care is discovered.
After several male escorts are assaulted and one is murdered, the team finds a link to a couple whose sexual fantasy may have turned violent.
The abduction of a young woman leads the detectives to suspect that a serial killer, known to have killed at least four, may be at work once again.
SVU and 2-7 discover serial rapes and murders of marginalised women, leading Carisi and ADA Price to pursue multiple charges against a suspect.

The rough terrain of a high-speed pursuit proves both dangerous and useful for deputies. Police find more than a stolen air conditioner in the trunk of a messy van.
NCIS investigate the Secretary of the Navy when her husband starts accusing her of attempting to murder him.
An unknown shooter causes chaos at an annual Thanksgiving 5K, and Kasie joins Knight for lunch at Knight's sister's house.
After Emily Harrison tells Danny and Baez she's concerned her abusive ex-boyfriend will repeat his behavior with his new girlfriend, Emily becomes the prime suspect when he's murdered.
Frank has very little information when a conflicted priest who could help find a missing boy refuses to break the seal of confession.
When the son of Frank's most outspoken critic is murdered, Frank and the boy's father must put aside their differences to seek justice.
The team investigate the death of a college student who was hit by a truck after inexplicably stripping in the street and running into the road.
The team are in Washington DC to celebrate the retirement of their former professor, but have to investigate when tragedy intervenes.
Parker discovers he's a victim of identity theft while investigating the unusual murder of a Navy ensign. Knight and Jimmy face hurdles in their relationship.
When an old pal of Torres' comes to him for guidance amid an undercover FBI operation and then disappears, NCIS helps track him down. McGee prepares to be a contestant on a game show.
In preparation for a role, a world-renowned actress shadows the NCIS team as they investigate a decapitation case.
Parker grapples with his emotions when a con man from his past turns up as a murder suspect.
NCIS investigates the death of a ride-share driver who was found after a car accident. Parker's dad, who is temporarily living with him, assists the team in their investigation.
The NCIS team starts to investigate who is responsible for a potential bio terror attack at a strip mall parking garage.
Detectives Benson and Stabler investigate the death of a young wife who was recently accused of assaulting a male stripper with a group of her girlfriends.
A case involves the beating of a seven-months-pregnant woman, whose unborn child has been torn from her body via a primitive Cesarean section.
Naval criminal investigators on the Hawaiian islands tackle the case of an experimental aircraft that crashes. The team must find who is behind it before state secrets are exposed.
The team must take down a notorious team of international thieves who are using explosives on armoured trucks before they complete their final job. Lucy and Whistler have a standoff.
After the remains of a woman who was murdered three years earlier are found in a backyard, a composite sketch leads detectives to her identical twin sister.
After the head of personnel at a software company is found raped and stabbed to death, the detectives need help from an FBI psychiatrist to solve their case.
A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.

A runaway biker makes multiple clumsy attempts to slip away from deputies. A young woman starts making unwise choices when her family leaves town.
When Eddie and Jamie become overly involved in a complicated adoption case between the birth and adoptive parents, they ask Erin to help them settle the dispute without going to court.
Danny Regan is moonlighting as a private security for an ex convict who wants to see his son. Jamie and Eddie have to break up an arguement on the street between two partners.
When diplomatic immunity complicates a child abuse case for Danny and Baez, Frank intervenes, despite not having jurisdiction on the case.
Murder mystery starring Peter Falk and Clive Revill. The dishevelled detective discovers a devious scheme of murder and terrorism behind the charm of an Irish poet.
Detective drama starring Peter Falk and Honor Blackman. In London, Columbo attempts to uncover the truth about a suspicious death during a production of Macbeth.
Detective drama starring Peter Falk and Richard Kiley. The chief of police becomes a suspect when he helps a desperate neighbour who has killed his wife.
Detective drama starring Peter Falk and Jackie Cooper. After a political campaigner is murdered, Columbo gets on the trail of a senatorial candidate.
Murder mystery drama starring Peter Falk and William Shatner. The dishevelled lieutenant must investigate when the producer of a TV detective show is murdered.
A six-year-old boy is shot and then abandoned in ER by his fearful mother, sending detectives in search of his missing family and the gunman before his mother becomes victim too.
Benson and Stabler have the gruesome task of identifying the remains of a man and a woman who were stabbed in a park.
Kai goes undercover with one of Hawai'i's oldest surf gangs when a petty officer who's trying to help wayward kids find a new path in the Marines is murdered.
The team investigate the shooting of a marine, which isn't as straightforward as it first seems, and Kai puts aside his feelings to help his father.
The team searches for a serial killer who justifies his crimes with paranoid religious motivation.
Drama series about an elite force which investigates sexual crimes. A woman brings charges of sexual abuse against her father, who is acquitted but then murdered.

An alleged burglar claims his sack full of money is a gift from his grandma. The discovery of a pink bandana leads deputies to question a suspect's story.

The NCIS team races to track down Ducky and Jimmy after the two disappear while transporting a body from a crime scene.
US naval police series. A media frenzy surrounding an unidentified criminal prompts Gibbs's barber to question his son as a prime suspect.
The wife of a marine who specialised in K-9 bomb detection urges the NCIS team to investigate the recent death of her husband in Afghanistan.
US drama series about the investigation and prosecution of crime. A bizarre investigation begins when a legal aid strike ends with the death of a paralegal.
The detectives hit the internet to investigate whether an online romance led to a mechanic's murder.
Powerful American crime drama. DA McCoy's job is on the line during the trial of a man accused of killing his jeweller brother-in-law over a prostitution ring.
Lupo and Bernard investigate the death of a war widow's child in a bombing.
US drama series about the investigation and prosecution of crime. Lupo and Bernard investigate the murder of a religious website's creator.
Lupo and Bernard investigate the possible hit-and-run death of the mistress of a failed investment bank CEO.
When a sergeant is killed in a suit store, the team presumes that a robbery went wrong. Then Tony and Tim discover that he may have been targeted.
When a suspected hit-and-run driver claims to have been committing murder elsewhere at the time, his lawyer alerts NCIS without breaking client confidentiality.
Gibbs recruits an analyst from the National Security Agency to help trap the people behind a bug found in a pen belonging to the Secretary of the Navy.
Benson and Fin investigate when a woman who has been raped and murdered is found next to her car.
When the parents of a teenage murder victim approach Stabler, he goes with Dr Huang to interview their prime suspect, a serial killer soon to be executed in a New Jersey prison.
